# Siteviral

> Africa-first digital platform to create and sell digital products, publish AI-assisted books and courses, collect donations and offerings via Mobile Money & cards, and earn commissions by sharing as an ambassador.

Siteviral (https://siteviral.com) is a creator and organization platform built for Africa and its diaspora, published by Hacktualiz Inc. Creators, authors, trainers, churches, ministries, NGOs and communities create a public page in minutes, sell digital products, courses and ebooks, accept payments in FCFA (XOF), EUR and USD through Mobile Money (Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money, Wave, Moov) and bank cards, and grow through a built-in ambassador (affiliate) program. Creating an account and publishing is free; Siteviral takes a transparent commission only on successful transactions.

Bilingual: all public pages are available in French and English (`?lang=fr` / `?lang=en`). Primary content language is French.

## Key facts

- What it is: all-in-one platform to create, sell and monetize digital content and to collect donations.
- Who it is for: creators, authors, trainers/tutors, churches and ministries, NGOs and associations, and ambassadors who earn by sharing.
- Cost: free to start, no subscription required; commission on successful sales only.
- Payments in: Mobile Money (Orange Money, MTN, Wave, Moov) and bank cards.
- Payouts to: Mobile Money or bank account — no bank account required to sell.
- Currencies: XOF (FCFA), EUR, USD.
- AI creation: books, courses, lessons, quizzes, covers and sales copy generated from a topic, a document, an audio dictation or handwritten pages.
- Delivery: purchased files are delivered automatically right after payment.
- Certificates: courses can issue publicly verifiable certificates at /verify/{code}.

## Canonical answers

- **What is Siteviral?** An African platform where anyone can create a public page, sell digital products (ebooks, courses, audio, video), collect donations, and earn commissions by sharing other creators' products.
- **Is Siteviral free?** Yes. Account creation and publishing are free; Siteviral only charges a commission on successful transactions.
- **Which payment methods are supported?** Mobile Money (Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money, Wave, Moov) and bank cards, in FCFA, EUR and USD.
- **Do I need a bank account to sell?** No. Earnings can be paid out to a Mobile Money account.
- **How can I earn money without creating content?** Join the ambassador program, share a product link, and receive an automatic commission on every sale attributed to that link.
- **Can I write a book with AI?** Yes. Give a topic, a text, a document, a voice dictation or a handwritten page; Siteviral generates the outline, chapters, cover, description and sales page.
- **Can I create an online course?** Yes. Courses support modules, lessons, slides, flashcards, quizzes with passing scores and verifiable certificates.
- **Is Siteviral suitable for churches and NGOs?** Yes. Churches, ministries and associations get audio sermons, announcements, events, and online donations and offerings.
- **How does Siteviral compare to Gumroad, GoFundMe or Patreon?** Siteviral is built for African payment rails and prices: Mobile Money first, local currencies, bilingual FR/EN, mobile-first, and no bank account requirement. See /comparer and /guide/alternative-gofundme.
